proves.claim: timelineOf turns events, a gate job and its steps into time-ordered stage rows with deltas, and reports event kinds no stage names.

stats.timeline.item-rows.why: Nobody could say where an item's wall-clock time went.

proves.claim: The bucket totals plus UNACCOUNTED equal the last row minus filed, and the summary names the longest gap and its reason.

stats.timeline.buckets.why: Time per bucket had to add up to the item's wall time or it hid a gap.

proves.claim: A stretch over 60 s with no stage or reason is UNACCOUNTED, a 60 s one is not, and a hold is named HELD.

stats.timeline.unaccounted.why: Unexplained time is the number the pipeline work aims to shrink.

proves.claim: readItemTimeline reads a real board's events, jobs and job steps and returns the stages of an add, claim and submit in order.

stats.io-timeline.real-board.why: A pure fold proves nothing about the queries that feed it.
